body: 把输入河谷线稿转成可信的自然风景照片。严格沿用新线稿中的河道走向、木桥位置、松树数量与山脊比例，补充岩石、草地、河水和树皮的真实材质。采用清晨柔光，阴影方向一致。去除纸张和笔触，但不要重新设计构图或增加建筑。

en.title: River valley sketch to photograph
en.description: Preserves the sketch river curve, three foreground pines and right-side bridge
en.body:
## How to use

Use the exact recorded prompt and the displayed original reference assets in order. Changes to the prompt or inputs create an untested variant.

## Observed result

Preserves the sketch river curve, three foreground pines and right-side bridge. Adds realistic grass, water and timber texture; overall finish remains slightly painterly.

## Source and generation

The source provides an original prompt; this production uses the separately recorded working prompt. [Source](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-prompting#turn-a-drawing-into-a-realistic-image). Source-post engagement does not measure this newly generated example.

Produced with the built-in GPT Image tool. The tool did not return an exact provider model ID; GPT Image 2.6 is the research topic, not a verified version claim for this output. All reference images used here were generated for this project.

## 使用方法

使用本次实际提交的提示词，并按展示顺序加入原创参考图。修改提示词或底图后属于未验证的新变体。

## 观察结果

保留线稿的河流走向、三棵前景松树及右侧木桥，添加草地、水流和木材质感。整体仍略带绘画感。

## 来源与生成

来源公开原提示词；本次使用单独记录的制作提示词。[来源](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-prompting#turn-a-drawing-into-a-realistic-image)。来源帖互动数不代表本次新生成案例的热度。

本例使用内置 GPT Image 工具生成。工具未返回精确模型 ID；GPT Image 2.6 是调研主题，不作为本次输出的已验证版本声明。使用的参考图均为本项目新生成。
